build.description: Build, commit, merge kob-dev → master, push, back to kob-dev
build.template:
Execute these steps in order (do NOT skip any):
1. Run `bun run build:only` to compile the binary
2. Run `git status --short` and stage all modified files with `git add`
3. Commit with message "build: <list changed files>"
4. Run `git checkout master`, `git merge kob-dev`, `git push origin master`
5. Run `git checkout kob-dev`, `git push origin kob-dev`
6. Confirm success with a one-line summary
